title: $6.3 Billion Stolen in 20 Minutes: The Biggest Crypto Hack Ever #shorts
description:
In about 20 minutes, hackers drained around $6.3 billion from Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange. It's the largest crypto theft on record, about four times the old record, the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025.

What we know so far (as of Oct 30, 2026):
- About $6.3 billion moved out of Binance's hot wallets across about 10 blockchains (Binance's estimate; other estimates range from $5.8 to $6.36 billion)
- Binance paused withdrawals; about $3 billion has been frozen with help from Tether and Circle
- Binance says it started with a hacked engineer's laptop; its co-CEO says the attack was more complex
- Blockchain investigators (TRM Labs, Chainalysis) link it to North Korean hackers; not officially confirmed
- Binance says it will cover customer losses from its own funds
- Bitcoin briefly fell below $77,000 that night

Details are still developing and may change. Follow for the full breakdown.

Sources: Binance statements; TRM Labs; Chainalysis; FBI PSA I-022625-PSA (Bybit, 2025); CNBC; NBC News; Bloomberg; CoinDesk; The Block; Forbes; Fox Business (Oct 29-30, 2026).

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
